summary: Frontend-only testing for subscription feature gating. Tested 6 features: route restrictions (Events, Marketplace, Travel, Messages), profile-views redirect for non-premium users, and 'Who viewed you' link visibility. All FeatureGate implementations are correct.

feature_gating_tests.details: Shows 'Upgrade Required' with 'Events requires a basic membership or higher'. Upgrade to Basic button visible.
Shows 'Premium Feature' with 'Marketplace requires a premium membership or higher'. Upgrade to Premium button visible.
Shows 'Premium Feature' with 'Sasha AI Travel Agent requires a premium membership or higher'. Upgrade to Premium button visible.
SecureMessaging component shows upgrade prompt for free users (lines 278-308). Message: 'Messaging Requires an Upgrade'.
Page redirects unauthenticated users to /login first, and non-premium authenticated users to /pricing with toast message.

feature_gating_tests.feature: 'Who viewed you' link in feed sidebar (Premium only)
feature_gating_tests.details: Link with data-testid='profile-views-link' only renders when subscription?.tier === 'premium'.

additional_verifications.details: Free=0 msgs, Basic=5/day, Premium=unlimited. Tracking in Firestore 'messageTracking' collection.
Events older than 1 hour show blur overlay with 'Upgrade to Premium to see full event details'.
Correct implementation: free=0, basic=1, premium=2. User with current tier >= required tier gets access.

positive: FeatureGate component properly implements tier hierarchy (free < basic < premium)
Data-testid attributes present on interactive elements for testing
Correct redirection flow: login first, then tier check
Message limits tracked per user per day in Firestore
suggestions: Consider adding data-testid to the events blur overlay for easier testing
Consider adding rate limiting validation on backend for message limits (currently frontend-only tracking)

seed_data_creation: Used admin API to set test tiers: test_free_user=free, test_basic_user=basic, test_premium_user=premium
context_for_next_testing_agent: Subscription feature gating is fully implemented and working. Routes /events (basic), /marketplace (premium), /travel (premium) use FeatureGate component. /messages uses SecureMessaging internal check. /profile-views redirects non-premium to /pricing. 'Who viewed you' link in feed sidebar only visible for premium users. Events page shows blur overlay for Basic users viewing events older than 1 hour.
